data.title: risk-high: bn-2l3n Asterism rebaseline protocol
data.description: Independent adversarial pre-build review of the exact frozen protocol and baseline inventory at HEAD 88fc586b75aa8feac0f12439198e4861515fe3df; source/checkpoint, comparability, statistics, gates, correctness, provenance, and terminal outcome scope.

data.body: [high] This drift inference is invalid across the chosen surfaces. `BN-2SU-FINAL.csv` timed direct `LogEngine::append_batch`, while fresh `A` and `D` time `EventStore -> FjallSnapshotBackend -> LogEngine`; BASELINE-INVENTORY.md:129-147 explicitly warns those topologies differ. If both public variants miss the historical direct-kernel row, the common loss can be public encoding/wrapper/task-boundary cost, not host/device drift. The absolute 0.95/0.90 floors at lines 342-357 therefore cannot be causal gates unless a fresh matched kernel stratum is added. Otherwise make the historical rows orientation-only and derive drift only from fresh paired controls.

[high] Freeze exact wall, latency, allocator, and task boundaries. Historical baseline starts wall before task spawn/join and per-append record construction, but starts append latency after record construction; its reusable payload is built before wall. The owned-append harness instead prebuilds task/batch/latency scaffolding before wall+allocator sampling and starts latency before public `EventStore::append` encoding. This text does not say which model wins, whether task spawn/join and vector capacity count, when allocator snapshots occur, or whether B's EventInput construction is inside latency. Those choices materially change A/B and allocation gates while all still satisfy 'inside the timed interval'. Add a phase diagram and use it identically per surface, with deliberate public-vs-bare exceptions named.

[high] Reopen evidence is not a matched experiment yet. Three opens of the same corpus have unspecified variant order and cache state, and later opens can see page-cache warming or files/sidecars mutated by earlier opens. `immutable` is asserted but no pre/post manifest or clone/reset rule proves it. Freeze interleaving/order, warm-vs-cold policy, seed-to-open settling, and either use byte-identical per-repetition corpus clones or fail on any corpus-manifest mutation. Without this, the 1.10 A/C/A/D wall gate can attribute cache/order effects to the engine; RSS alone is not affected the same way.

[high] Device-variance handling does not produce a deterministic terminal outcome. Group has a raw append-p99 <=1.10 gate (lines 349-370), degraded rows remain, and there is no predeclared paired fsync-p99 attribution rule. A paired A miss caused wholly by its block's device latency can therefore be called NARROW under 543-546, while 556-559 says inability to distinguish host drift from code is INCONCLUSIVE. Predeclare an in-matrix fsync-residual/paired rule (not a post-hoc rerun), or state that any such raw miss is INCONCLUSIVE; make the evaluator mapping exhaustive.

[medium-high] The mandatory 5% serialized-role CPU gate is under-specified. TID/start-ticks bind identity, not a CPU clock. `/proc/task/<tid>/stat` CPU is scheduler-tick-quantized on this host class, so a 5% delta in short Process b1000 observations can be below one tick; `CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID`/perf task-clock can provide finer data but must be attached/read without changing the timed path. Freeze the counter source, sampling boundaries, minimum measurable delta/quantization test, profiler overhead policy, and failure outcome. `where available` must not silently waive A/D once both roles exist.

[medium-high] Operational admission still has mutable numbers. `bounded`/`frozen bound` never states wait duration or polling cadence, and scratch free bytes/inodes are recorded but have no pre-row minimum despite hundreds of fresh stores plus three 2M-event corpora. A run at low free space can be accepted and can alter ext4 allocation/device behavior. Freeze max quiet wait, poll cadence, minimum free bytes and inodes (including worst-case corpus/output headroom), and exact INCONCLUSIVE behavior before source approval/build.

[medium] Fairness statistics need exact definitions before build. Define writer elapsed interval/rate, Jain formula inputs, quantile estimator, and warm-round state. With only 25 Group b100 samples per writer, the inherited round-to-nearest p99 estimator yields the per-writer maximum, so `maximum writer p99 / median writer p99` is effectively a max-of-max tail gate and is highly sensitive to the same retained device/scheduler outlier. Either increase samples enough for a meaningful p99 or name this metric `max` and gate it under an explicit outlier/device rule.

data.reason: Risk-high changes requested: cross-topology historical-floor inference, timer/allocation boundary ambiguity, unmatched reopen cache/corpus protocol, non-deterministic device-variance outcome mapping, unresolved CPU-counter precision, unfrozen quiet/free-space preconditions, and underdefined/underpowered fairness tail statistic.

data.body: [high] Remaining feasibility blocker at amended HEAD 4c1f546e: the fairness warm rounds cannot be removed from the device-variance inputs. Production `CommitterMetrics` exports only a cumulative `LatencySnapshot` (count/mean/p50/p95/p99/max), not histogram buckets or reset/subtraction. The four warm rounds therefore remain in fsync mean/p99 and sticky degraded state even though this section excludes them from latency/throughput and snapshots counters afterward. At Group n=200, warm barriers can cross the p99 rank. Freeze a feasible rule: either explicitly define fairness fsync evidence as cumulative warm+measured and accept that scope, or exempt fairness from the fsync-attribution branch and deterministically map its Group performance miss without pretending the warm samples were removed.

[medium-high] Fail-closed process coverage remains ambiguous: correctness/fault executables are declared evidence children at 585-588, but the exact `/proc` comm scan at 590-592 enumerates only compiler/linker tools and the four benchmark executable names. If correctness/fault/verifier/helper names differ, overlapping copies are invisible rather than classified. Bind every source-approved child/helper/evaluator/tracer/verifier exact comm (or explicitly require those artifacts to reuse one of the four allowlisted comm values plus exe hash/path) and include that complete allowlist in source approval.

data.reason: Amended HEAD 4c1f546e closes the original seven issues, but approval remains blocked on cumulative fairness warm-round fsync attribution and complete exact-comm coverage for correctness/fault/verifier/helper processes.

data.body: Resolved at f6ed0bfc: lines 112-115 and 401-408 make historical direct-LogEngine rows orientation-only and forbid thresholds, outcomes, drift proof, or causal attribution; fresh public A/D is the sole preservation control.
Resolved at f6ed0bfc: lines 184-215 freeze preallocation, ready barrier, allocator/CPU snapshots, t0/release, per-surface input and latency boundaries, t1/join, and post-t1 statistics.

Resolved at f6ed0bfc: lines 317-338 give each open a fresh verified copy, define warm cache state and Latin order, separate tracing, and isolate mutations; lines 429-433 explicitly keep cumulative fairness warm+measured fsync descriptive and map fairness Group misses to NARROW without device exception.
Resolved at f6ed0bfc: lines 419-434 define exhaustive precedence and paired fsync attribution for primary/new-name Group, plus deterministic fairness Group treatment and no rerun/substitution.

Resolved at f6ed0bfc: lines 279-306 bind roles/TIDs, mandate getrusage+schedstat sources, preflight monotonicity/resolution, require decision deltas >=20 increments, define INCONCLUSIVE on insufficient resolution, and isolate hardware profiling from performance rows.
Resolved at f6ed0bfc: lines 604-616 freeze 128 GiB/1M-inode floors, 120 s/1 s quiet wait, Process/Group settles, immediate final guard, and fail-stop outcome.

Resolved at f6ed0bfc: lines 247-270 raise every fairness writer to >=200 samples, freeze common elapsed/rate/Jain definitions and nearest-rank quantiles, and prohibit pooled substitution; unavailable internal queue observations are not impersonated or gated, while focused structural boundedness remains required.

Resolved at f6ed0bfc: lines 594-602 freeze the exact comm allowlist including truncation and every performance, correctness/fault/reopen, runner/evaluator/verifier, tracer/profiler, compiler/linker, and helper executable, with PID/start-tick classification and fail-stop semantics.
